prescribedGeometry.description: Operator-selected exact eight-member F6c 4:4 prescribed history. The two polarity sectors share the owner-defined tetrahedral axes, circulation signs, and module phase offsets while using small asymmetric axial and radial counter-breathing over one 2*pi display period. This is a prescribed visualization only; no EOM evolution or retention, stability, binding, energy, particle-identity, or physical-realization claim is implied.

choices: The operator approved the recommended small asymmetric counter-breathing visualization on 2026-08-26.
Both sectors use h_base=rho_base=0.30, theta_rate=1, zero breathing phases, and no phase modulation.
The positive sector uses axial amplitude +0.040 and radial amplitude +0.025; the negative sector uses axial amplitude -0.030 and radial amplitude -0.020.
All axial and radial breathing angular frequencies equal 1, so the complete prescribed display closes after 2*pi.
The asymmetry is a visualization choice and does not establish an EOM-solver trajectory or a physical distinction between the sectors.
